mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market that reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) with unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5%, a deepening recession signals negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation rate (measured by PAYEMS growth) consistently indicates improving job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), a concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in consumer spending away from durable goods, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST declines, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.
